reconciliation.scope: Reconcile metadata in two live source indices with six existing runtime regions. Chapter order follows PowerPyx numbering. Chart entries preserve Steam headings and are not a certified in-game chart census. A bounded Shades of Color guide/chart review now supplies its Markus attribution; other chapter bodies remain outside this inventory check.
limitations: 32 numbered chapters include Opening, which has no separate Steam chart heading.
39 Steam chart/route headings are reconciled to 31 non-Opening chapters. Headings do not establish complete in-game chart cardinality.
22 early chart entries retain null character values. Shades of Color now has a separate, source-reviewed Markus attribution beyond the index headings.
On the Run has one unsplit index heading. Its possible character subdivisions remain unresolved.

The original reconciliation used index metadata only. The bounded Shades of Color follow-up inspects its chart images and chapter guide for character attribution. Other chapter images, guide corpora, gameplay and platform/build differences remain uninspected in this inventory.
Existing Hostage checked-against-chart status applies only to its documented visible-chart scope. Other existing runtime regions, including the integrated Shades of Color slice, remain partial.
Source-derived metadata and title attribution do not grant publication rights under the repository MIT license.

unknowns.explanation: The two indices reconcile as source metadata. They do not establish every in-game chart or route subdivision. Inspect chart identifiers or an authoritative game inventory before a complete census claim.

The 22 early entries with character=null lack character attribution in the inspected index headings. Do not infer them from story knowledge. Shades of Color is separately attributed to Markus by the bounded chapter-source review.
Both indices use one On the Run heading. Separate character-chart cardinality remains unresolved.
PowerPyx calls Opening a cutscene without tasks and Steam omits it. This supports the empty charts array only within index scope, not a game observation.
The finale has six Steam route headings under three PowerPyx character links. Exact in-game chart boundaries and route prerequisites are outside this inventory.
No new permission or reuse license was established. Metadata collection does not clear third-party chart images, expression or guide arrangement for publication.
